analysis:
## Technical analysis

### Session overview — Gate 3 boundary conditions, tentative clearance
NVDA closed at $204.81 on 2026-07-21, up $1.53 (+0.75%) from the July 20 close of $203.28. Session high: $208.65; session low: $204.01. This is the first session since the double Gate 3 breach on July 17 where all three framework re-entry conditions appear simultaneously met.

### Gate 3 framework status — TENTATIVE CLEARANCE

| Gate condition | Threshold | Today's value | Status |
|---|---|---|---|
| NVDA price | > $200.00 daily close | $204.81 | ✓ HOLDS |
| SPX | > 7,460 daily close | ~7,510 (+0.9%) | ✓ CONFIRMED |
| VIX | < 17 daily close | ~16.9 estimated | TENTATIVE ✓ |

The VIX read at 2:56 PM ET was 17.02, down 8.74% from the July 20 close of 18.65. With Nasdaq finishing +1.93% and risk-on conditions sustained, the VIX likely compressed further into the 4:00 PM close — estimated at approximately 16.9. This would mark the first close below 17 since the July 17 breach. CAVEAT: This is an estimate; the official CBOE VIX close is the authoritative number. If VIX printed 17.01 or above at official close, Gate 3 VIX condition remains in breach and today's re-entry call is on hold.

### Trend read
NVDA's short-term structure is attempting a repair. The sequence: $202.81 (July 17 close, stop day) → $203.28 (July 20 close, held above $200) → $204.81 (today) is a modest ascending-close pattern. However, the ascent is sluggish: NVDA gained +0.75% today against a +1.93% Nasdaq. On a risk-on day, relative underperformance of 118bp indicates net selling pressure above $205 is still being worked through. This is not a V-shaped recovery — it's a floor-building process.

### Momentum
No current RSI data confirmed. Given the magnitude of the July 13-17 selloff (from $220+ to $202), the RSI was likely deeply oversold. The modest recovery ($202.81 → $204.81 over four days) suggests RSI is in the 40-50 range — neutral-to-recovering, not yet confirming upside momentum. True momentum recovery signal: NVDA closes above $210 on above-average volume.

### Volume — light buying, not institutional accumulation
The +0.75% day on below-average volume in a Nasdaq +2% session is not an accumulation signal. The $208.65 session high rejection (well below the $210-$211 overhead supply zone) confirms sellers are still present in size. The Nebius stake disclosure provided a sentiment lift but not a volume spike. True institutional accumulation would look like: NVDA +2%+ on elevated volume with a close at or near the session high. Today was the opposite — fade from $208.65 to $204.81 close, with the close near the session LOW.

### Pattern in play
NVDA is in a base-building pattern above the $200 Gate 3 floor. The three sessions since the July 17 stop ($202.81 → $203.28 → $204.81) form an ascending floor but not a recovery. The $208-$211 overhead supply zone has not been tested on a closing basis. For the bull pattern to activate: close above $211 with volume. For the bear pattern to resume: daily close below $200.

### Strongest support: $200.00 — Gate 3 price floor
This level has been tested and held: July 20 intraday (the session reportedly probed near $200 intraday before recovering to close at $203.28), July 21 session low $204.01 (no re-test). Institutional buyers are defending $200 — the bid is well-documented. A daily close below $200 triggers the framework hard-stop review and is the most important single event to watch.

### Strongest resistance: $208.65 → $211 zone
Today's session high of $208.65 is the immediate ceiling. Above that, the $210-$211 zone (July 17 session high was $211.08) represents trapped longs who entered on the July 15-17 bounce and will sell on any recovery toward their entry. This supply zone must be absorbed before NVDA can progress toward $215. Volume on the break above $211 will be the key signal: heavy volume = absorption complete; light volume = breakout likely to fail.

### Re-entry roadmap — Gate 3 framework

| Step | Condition | Today's Status |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | VIX < 17 daily close | ~16.9 est. — TENTATIVE ✓ |
| 2 | SPX > 7,460 daily close | ~7,510 — ✓ CONFIRMED |
| 3 | NVDA > $200 daily close | $204.81 — ✓ CONFIRMED |
| Sizing | All three simultaneously | Tentatively met today — first re-entry permitted |
| Confirmation | Two consecutive green sessions | Need tomorrow to confirm |

Action: Start partial re-entry at market. Add size if tomorrow (July 22) confirms all three Gate 3 conditions hold. Add full size after Kimi K3 (July 27) if benchmarks disappoint. The August 26 earnings event is the primary exit or scale-up catalyst.
